propositions: _build_datacenter must assert non-secret scope readiness (base_url and project) at build time, matching the fail-closed placement of _build_cloud's assert_cloud_scope_ready, while keeping PAT and network validation lazy in _LazyDataCenterClient
assert_datacenter_nonsecret_scope_ready should validate only base_url and jira.project presence, raising BackendEnvError when either is empty, and must run even when test transport is injected

assert_cloud_scope_ready's stricter checks (JIRA_USER email format, non-empty project) versus legacy ambient assert_env_ready must be documented as an intentional, canonical tightening, not accidental drift
Composing and building a DataCenter backend must remain possible without JIRA_PAT and without the [agents] jira extra import at build time, with PAT validation deferred to lazy client construction
The fail-closed scope-validation asymmetry between Cloud and DataCenter backends must be removed while preserving the lazy-validation design for DC authentication and network checks
